summary: Tested iteration 18 (multi-project Tuya aggregation). 7/8 backend tests pass. Frontend fully validated (Paramètres tab, multi-projects text, Catalogue QR shows project_name, discover button works). One CRITICAL backend bug found in POST /api/installations/{iid}/discover?source=tuya: returns 502 when a project errors AND the responding project(s) return 0 devices, which contradicts the requirement.

critical.issue: Returns 502 'Connexion impossible aux projets' when a bogus/broken project exists AND all responding projects return 0 devices. The condition at server.py:1102 `if not tuya_devices and errors` conflates 'no devices' with 'no project responded'. Per requirement, endpoint must respond 200 (empty list is OK) as long as at least one project responds, even if that project has 0 devices. Real 'Projet Tuya' has 0 devices linked -> bogus 2nd project pushes tuya_devices=[] & errors=[bogus], triggering 502.

action_items: Fix server.py discover_tuya_devices(): track a 'succeeded' counter and only raise 502 when NO project succeeded, not when device list is empty. Suggestion: `succeeded = 0` in loop, `succeeded += 1` in try-branch after fetch_all_tuya_devices; then `if succeeded == 0 and errors: raise HTTPException(502, ...)`. This preserves the intent while allowing empty-but-successful projects (0 real devices) to return 200 with [].
critical_code_review_comments: catalog_discover (server.py:732) correctly aggregates and tolerates project failures — returns {items, errors} shape as required, no HTTPException raised when at least one project fails.

discover_tuya_devices (server.py:1090) has a subtle bug: uses `not tuya_devices` as proxy for 'no project responded' — should use a success counter instead. Currently breaks the 'at least one project responds with 0 devices' scenario.
public_catalog correctly hides tuya_id and exposes project_name.
associate-qr correctly hides tuya_id from device response (line 1201).
Frontend CatalogManager correctly handles {items, errors} shape, shows project_name in cards, no crash on the new response shape.

rca of the issue: Repro: (1) POST /api/admin/tuya/projects with bogus access_id/secret — creates a 2nd project. (2) POST /api/installations/{iid}/discover?source=tuya. Expected: 200 [] (real project responded with 0 devices, bogus one errored). Actual: 502 'Connexion impossible aux projets : TEST_BOGUS_...'. Root cause at server.py:1102-1103: `if not tuya_devices and errors: raise HTTPException(502, ...)`. When the sole succeeding project has 0 devices linked, tuya_devices ends up empty and errors is non-empty, so the guard falsely fires. Mitigation: replace with a `succeeded` counter that increments after each successful fetch_all_tuya_devices call, and only raise 502 when `succeeded == 0 and errors`. This matches catalog_discover's tolerant pattern.
